I'm examining the layout for the HeroTitleBlock, which has horizontal padding of 56 and centers its columns with no height constraint. In DotHero, there’s a Positioned widget at the top, but it has no height, so the HeroTitleBlock's child will take its height based on text. I need to ensure the overlay isn’t too tall and that it doesn’t clip the dot. If the dot is centered, it could potentially overlap with the overlay, which is something to watch out for!

I could create a column for the title and the dot, ensuring the dot stays centered and pulses. I should check the app's typography for definitions too!
